trustedOrigin.accessor: import.meta.env.SITE in future Astro-compiled server call site; installed Astro source maps it directly from config.site
trustedOrigin.recommendation: Owner confirms committed canonical production site is the intended Home Cottage origin; confirmation suffices to select the production candidate without editing astro.config.mjs or adding a new production origin key. No value was set or selected in Y.
trustedOrigin.transformation: First require a nonempty trusted configuration string with no surrounding whitespace, parse new URL(trustedSiteUrl), reject credentials and non-HTTP(S) protocols, then use url.origin as the one exact expectedOrigin. Production policy requires HTTPS. A syntactically valid URL is trusted only because it came from approved configuration.

normalization.trailingSlashAndPath: Trusted site URLs may include a trailing slash/path; URL.origin removes path/query/fragment. Do not pass full URL/path to M, which requires origin === input.
normalization.ports: WHATWG URL canonicalization omits default HTTP/HTTPS ports and preserves nondefault ports. Scheme, canonical host and effective port are significant to exact matching.
normalization.https: Production source must use HTTPS; reject downgrade instead of broadening trust.
normalization.localhostDev: Separate explicitly approved local origin, normally HTTP localhost with exact port, in local-only trusted configuration. Never infer it from a request or add it to production trust.
normalization.malformed: Reject absent, non-string, whitespace-changing, unparsable, opaque, credential-bearing or disallowed-protocol configuration before handler creation. No default/request-derived fallback.

trustedOrigin.mPolicy: FOOD-002M canonicalOrigin accepts HTTP(S) only with parsed origin exactly equal to its input; incoming Origin and configured expectedOrigin must both be canonical and exactly equal. Missing/noncanonical Origin is rejected. One origin per boundary, no allowlist expansion.
trustedOrigin.environments: Production uses owner-confirmed canonical site. Local and preview/staging, if desired, each need their own explicit trusted site mapping/configuration and isolated admin/database plan before use. Do not silently reuse production settings or add preview origins to the production boundary.
trustedOrigin.configImpact: No production site-config patch needed if committed candidate is confirmed. Only later route wiring of import.meta.env.SITE and validation is required. Local/preview overrides remain optional separately approved work, not a new file created here.

corsCsrf.conclusion: No additional CSRF token mechanism is required by inspected contracts/precedents for this POST-only private mutation boundary: M requires an exact canonical trusted Origin before body access, then gate authorization and fresh mutation authorization. Preserve this policy without duplicating request checks or introducing CORS relaxation.
corsCsrf.limits: This conclusion assumes no alternate mutation route bypasses M and no acceptance of absent Origin or request-derived expectedOrigin. Same-origin script compromise is not prevented by this policy. Revisit only if later route scope changes these assumptions.
